stories.title: CPSC Recalls Multiple Amazon Baby Loungers — Suffocation and Fall Hazards
stories.angle: CPSC recalled Vevor Baby Loungers (sold Nov 2024–Jan 2026, ~$30, Amazon/VEVOR.com/Wayfair) and CooCooBaby Baby Loungers (~2,355 units) for entrapment, suffocation, and fall hazards. Safety-first Tier 1 story.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: ⚠️ RECALL: Multiple Amazon baby loungers recalled by CPSC — suffocation and fall hazards. Brands include Vevor and CooCooBaby. If you have a baby lounger bought online in the last 18 months, check CPSC.gov now. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Vevor baby loungers: sold Nov 2024–Jan 2026, ~$30 on Amazon, VEVOR.com, and Wayfair. CooCooBaby loungers: ~2,355 units recalled. Hazards: entrapment, suffocation, and fall. Stop use and visit CPSC.gov for remedy details. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: CPSC Recalls Multiple Amazon Baby Loungers Over Suffocation and Fall Hazards

x_posts.text: 🎈 The 50th annual Labor Day Lift Off is coming to Memorial Park — Sep 5–7, 2026. Free admission. Hot air balloons, music, food, and ~200,000 of your neighbors. Pre-order parking for $15. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: CDC Study — Flu Vaccines Cut Children's Death Risk by 80%
stories.angle: CDC study in Pediatrics: flu vaccines cut children's flu death risk by 80%. 2026–27 update: injectable vaccines carry new febrile seizure warning for under-5. AAP still recommends vaccination. Talk to pediatrician before September.

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text: CDC study in Pediatrics: flu vaccines reduce children's risk of dying from flu by 80%. The AAP recommends flu shots for all kids 6 months and older — every year, starting as early as September. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text: New for 2026–27: injectable flu vaccines have updated warnings for kids under 5 (febrile seizure risk from postmarketing data). The AAP still recommends vaccination — talk to your pediatrician about the best option. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

article.headline: Flu Vaccines Reduce Children's Death Risk by 80%, CDC Study Finds — What Colorado Springs Parents Need to Know for 2026–27
